properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js ships SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations to any code that reaches it — transitively available to the whole ethers/ethereumjs stack this monorepo builds on.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 31 sites in the two shipped rich-wallets.ts modules (hardhat-zksync-deploy, hardhat-zksync-ethers) plus example/test constants hardcode the zkSync Era 'rich wallet' secp256k1 ECDSA private keys — the intentionally public, documented local-node test accounts (0x7726827...d4110 etc.) every zkSync tutorial uses. Genuine key material committed in shipped source, but public by design; only meaningful on a local in-memory node. packages/hardhat-zksync-telemetry/src/index.ts:5 is a different kind: a ha

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The secp256k1 curve is mandated by the zkSync/Ethereum protocol itself for transaction and EIP-712 signing — observable here, replaceable only by a protocol-level decision, not by this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 locked in pnpm-lock.yaml as a dependency of ssh2@1.17.0 — dependency inventory. The bcrypt-based KDF (OpenSSH private-key decryption path) ships in this build's ssh2 tree; no first-party call site in the plugin source. Changeable here by bumping or dropping ssh2.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@1.0.3 locked in pnpm-lock.yaml as a dependency of browserify-aes@1.2.0 (the crypto-browserify polyfill family) — dependency inventory. Ships OpenSSL's legacy single-round MD5-based EVP_BytesToKey KDF in the tree; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 locked in pnpm-lock.yaml, reached via ssh2@1.17.0 → bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (the dockerode/docker-modem toolchain tree); tweetnacl@1.0.3 also present via @metamask/eth-sig-util@4.0.1. Ed25519 signing available in the shipped dependency tree; no first-party call site in the plugin source. Changeable here by pruning dev tooling deps.

properties.name: pqs:context
